§6Artificial Xen Crystal & Ghiorsium§f

§aTwo exotic endgame materials, one for black holes, one for radiation shielding.§f

§6Artificial Xen Crystal§f:
Crafted: §e7 Energy Powder§f + §e1 Euphemium Ingot§f in a table. Place it and it teleports a chunk of ground §e75 blocks§f into the air.

§bUses§f:
§b• Miniature Black Hole§f, §e6 Xen Crystals§f + Singularity, the best DFC core (§e800×§f multiplier)
§b• Xenium Resonator§f, §e1 Xen Crystal§f + Steel, Starmetal, Polymer, and Military Grade Circuits
§b• Dyson Receivers§f, used in the Space Fork for advanced space infrastructure

§6Ghiorsium-336§f:
A non-fissile radioisotope (§e5 RAD/s§f) produced by recycling long-lived nuclear waste from schrabidium fuels or flashlead fuels. Stable for such a heavy element.

§bUses§f:
§b• Radiation Shielding§f, heavy shielding material due to stability
§b• Armor Inserts§f, provides radiation protection in armor
§b• Cladding and Billet Forms§f, used in advanced fuel elements

§ePS:§f Xen crystals are gated behind euphemium. Ghiorsium is a byproduct of schrabidium fuel processing, so if you're burning schrabidium fuels, you're already producing it.
